{{Hatnote|For the era overview and set catalogue, see [[Virtual Modern]]. For the constructed format, see [[Open]].}}
[[File:V0-D-imperialjustice-2018-07-08.gif|thumb|right|220px|link=Imperial Justice (V) (Virtual Set 0)|[[Imperial Justice (V) (Virtual Set 0)|Imperial Justice]], blanked in March 2021.]]
'''Virtual Modern release and update history''' covers [[Players Committee]] set releases and card changes following the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]]. New sets expanded the card pool, while errata changed previously released cards and blanking withdrew particular Virtual cards from [[Open]]. Updates also changed some [[Decipher era|Decipher]] cards used in the Modern game.<ref name="modern-releases" />

The Committee issued errata both with new sets and between releases. On 9 August 2022 it announced changes effective with [[Virtual Set 19]] on 15 August; a separate update on 1 July took effect immediately.<ref name="change-2022-08-15-errata" /><ref name="change-2022-07-01-errata" />

== Card changes ==

Errata can change game text, statistics, icons or a card's title. '''Blanking''' removes a Virtual card from the [[Open]] card pool; it does not create a card with blank game text. A blanked card can later return with errata: [[A Brave Resistance (Errata 4)|A Brave Resistance]] was blanked on 15 July 2023 and [[A Brave Resistance (Errata 6)|returned with revised text]] in October.<ref name="change-2023-07-15-blanking" /><ref name="change-2023-10-restoration" />

Before blanking, A Brave Resistance increased Force generation at Jakku and exchanged Resistance characters. The October 2023 version replaced those functions with limited Resistance leader searches, forfeit and power bonuses, and cancellation of [[Strike Planning]].<ref name="change-2023-10-restoration" />

<gallery mode="packed" heights="300" caption="A Brave Resistance before blanking and on its return">
File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-2022-07.png|link=A Brave Resistance (Errata 4)|[[A Brave Resistance (Errata 4)|Before blanking]] — July 2023.
File:V9-L-A_Brave_Resistance-2023-10.png|link=A Brave Resistance (Errata 6)|[[A Brave Resistance (Errata 6)|Returned with errata]] — October 2023.
</gallery>

For example, the 2019 errata text for [[Dark Hours (PC Errata 2019 E card)|Dark Hours]] targets non-droid characters one at a time and explicitly prevents sleeping characters from piloting, driving or moving.<ref name="change-2019-dark-hours" />

== Chronology ==

The chronology includes original set releases, separate [[Virtual Set P]] waves and subsequent updates. Effective dates are shown separately from release or announcement dates. Month-only entries identify the Committee's dated update sheets. Set articles contain their card lists.<ref name="modern-releases">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual Slips / Files]. Star sites.<br />[[Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend]]: While communing, restricts deployment to the permitted Jedi group, improves Jedi destiny and battle power, and exchanges a hand card for the />[[Rose Tico]]: Can send Finn to Used Pile instead of losing him and can take a hit in place of the player's starship or another Resistance character during battle.<br />[[There Is Another]]: Redirects the opponent's Luke-targeting Objective and Death Star II Effects to Leia, removes We're The Bait, and prevents the opponent's own Objective Force loss.<br />[[Free Ride & •Endor Celebration (V)|Free Ride & •Endor Celebration]]: Provides named cancellation options, a spy-or-unpiloted-vehicle removal option, and temporary suspension of A Million Voices Crying Out and An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops.<br />[[Jedi Levitation (V)|Jedi Levitation]]: Its Used function takes a just-drawn character into hand or cancels and redraws that destiny; its Lost function offers a once-per-game character retrieval for 4 Force.<br />[[The Force Is Strong In My Family]]: Retains the chosen Skywalker-family setup and explicitly prevents the player's lightsabers from being stolen.<br />[[City In The Clouds / You Truly Belong Here With Us]]: Uses Cloud City icons instead of the Premium icon, permits Weather Vane at setup, and supports Cloud City battleground searches.<br />[[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance|He Is The Chosen One]]: Starts Anakin's Funeral Pyre, Prophecy Of The Force, Ewok Village and I Feel The Conflict, with restrictions supporting the original-film Luke/Jedi strategy.<br />[[Old Allies / We Need Your Help]]: Starts the Episode VII Falcon at Jakku, permits Graveyard Of Giants, and combines Jakku occupation with conditional Force-loss reduction and Resistance battle support.<br />[[I Am Part Of The Living Force]]: Starts Communing with an eligible Jedi stacked on it, then deploys up to three free table Effects always immune to Alter.<br />[[Endor: Anakin's Funeral Pyre|Endor: Anakin’s Funeral Pyre]]: Has blank Dark Side text; its Light Side searches for Like My Father Before Me after the I Have It choice and allows free battles while Anakin is communing.<br />[[They Have No Idea We're Coming / Until We Win, Or The Chances Are Spent|They Have No Idea We’re Coming]]: Starts Scarif, Data Vault with Stardust and Massassi War Room, makes key characters spies, and searches for Rogue One, a corvette or a Scarif site.<br />[[The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker|We Need Luke Skywalker]]: The back side places Luke out of play, stops weapon firing for that battle, limits opposing attrition immunity, and supports Resistance drains and destiny redraws.<br />[[Death Star: Detention Block Corridor (V)|Death Star: />[[Endor: Ewok Village (V)|Endor: Ewok Village (LIGHT)]]: Prints two Light Side and one Dark Side icons, prevents starships and vehicles, and restricts Prophecy Of The Force relocation while Luke is there.<br />[[Lothal|Lothal (LIGHT)]]: Discounts Hera and searches for This Is MY Ship!, with conditional Force-drain and conversion-related Force-icon text.<br />Macroscan (V) (Set10): Blanked.<ref with1 Force loss if hit by Ahsoka or a Padawan.<br />[[Madakor In Radiant VII]]: Renames Obi-Wan In Radiant VII; changes stats/pilot to Madakor ability 2, adds passengers, protects total battle destiny and adds attrition immunity.<br />[[Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V)|Han’s Heavy Blaster Pistol]]: December2024 broadens smuggler deployment, changes cancelers and removes Han’s weapon-destiny cancellation.<br />[[Dash In Rogue 12 (Errata)|Dash In Rogue 12]]: Replaces drawing two and choosing one with protection for other T-47s.<br />A Good Blaster At Your Side & Restricted Deployment: | data-sort-value="2026-03" | March 2026 sheet<br />Announced 17 February 2026 ||  || <span id="2026-03-tweak"></span>'''Card update'''<br />[[The First Order Was Just The Beginning]]: Requires Map, changes location/icon support and removes deployment from Lost Pile; only non-unique troopers gain forfeit.<br />[[The Emperor, Relentless]]: Renames The Emperor (V), changes printed destiny to 6 and replaces most text; deployment is no longer limited to Coruscant.<br />[[Zuckuss (V)|Zuckuss]]: If present, or piloting an independent starship during battle, can set a just-drawn destiny to the printed destiny of the opponent’s top Lost Pile card; attrition immunity scales with completed weapon destiny draws.<br />[[Crush The Rebellion (V)|Crush The Rebellion]]: Rewritten around Shield Gate and Imperial support, including Devastator recruitment and Vader protection.<br />[[With Thunderous Applause]]: Taxation now puts away a politician; a Hovercam download replaces the activation option.<br />[[Ominous Rumors (V)|Ominous Rumors]]: Replaces persistent activation and broad Force Pile selection with one-time activation/Endor Shield handling and revised cancelers.<br />[[Emperor's Orders|Emperor’s Orders]]: Becomes an on-table system-pulling support card; revises Flagship Operations and related-system battle bonuses.<br />[[Scarif: Command Center]]: Adds Krennic deployment and receives the converted-Scarif-site raising function.<br />[[The Empire's Back (V)|The Empire’s Back]]: Replaces much of its former function with revised Interrupt-grabbing/recycling support and reshuffling.<br />[[D'Qar|D’Qar]]: Dark activation becomes once per game; Light’s drain reduction is replaced by a card pull.<br />[[Scarif: Citadel Tower]]: Replaces its text and transfers converted-site raising to Command Center.<br />[[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)|Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man]]: Broadens Clash protection, directly cancels Old Ben and replaces its other functions.<br />[[Understand Art, Understand A Species]]: A Used Interrupt offering Force loss after an Imperial leader wins, suspension of Ancient Watering Hole, or retrieval and opponent Force loss when four artwork cards are held.<br />[[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon]]: Starts the Death Star/Scarif locations and supports non-unique Imperials; flips with a leader on Scarif and the Death Star orbiting it. The back supports related battles, non-unique retrieval and Vader moving to a battle.<br />[[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don’t Alter It Any Further]]: Bars Death Star II Executor, pulls support only during the player’s turn and after flipping, and replaces the old freezing/forfeit functions with Lando destiny modification.<br />[[The First Order Reigns / The Resistance Is Doomed]]: Starts a Crait battleground rather than Bridge, can pull Bridge or Supremacy, fixes Supremacy’s deploy at 7 and removes the global power bonus; retains the Tracked Fleet flip condition.<br />[[We're Leaving (V)|We’re Leaving]]: Restricted to Podracing, can stack multiple credits and no longer pulls a starship; suppresses arena generation during the race.<br />[[Be With Me]]: Deploys on table and supports all Rey versions; Jedi bonuses count those on table and out of play.<br />[[A Brave Resistance]]: March2026 changes its condition from a Jakku location to an Episode VII Objective.<br />[[How Liberty Dies]]: Taxation now puts away a politician and downloads the Hovercam.<br />[[A Jedi's Fury|A Jedi’s Fury]]: March2026 makes it a Lost Interrupt requiring His Destiny, replaces pile manipulation and changes lightsaber recovery.<br />[[Courage Of A Skywalker (V)|Courage Of A Skywalker]]: Replaces its drawn-destiny bonus with a conditional battle destiny adder and changes saber functions to downloads.<br />[[Either Way, You Win (V)|Either Way, You Win]]: Replaces the Qui-Gon power option with player choices and simplifies the remaining weapon protection.<br />[[My Sister Has It]]: Replaces unlimited battle destiny draws with immunity cancellation; other functions remain.<br />[[Eventually You'll Lose (V)|Eventually You’ll Lose]]: March2026 requires Podracing, also pulls Amidala and replaces its Lost function with a Used damage function.<br />[[The Hidden Path / Gather Allies And Train]]: Forbids Anakin and A Jedi’s Resilience in addition to the other deck restrictions; retains the survivor deployment discount and Jedi movement/damage functions on the back.<br />[[Kashyyyk: Kachirho]]: Replaces Dark’s ability threshold for battle destiny with a first-character deployment tax.<br />[[The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker|The Galaxy May Need A Legend]]: March2026 changes its start, tightens character restrictions and removes location-pull costs; front only.<br />[[Podrace Prep (V)|Podrace Prep]]: Starts the Podrace package and three free Effects when Credits Will Do Fine is on table; the opponent may deploy a Podracer or play a Defensive Shield. Announced as a Set 27 preview card.<br />[[Death Star: Central Core (Virtual Set 15)|Death Star: Central Core (LIGHT)]]: Replaces both sides’ text, removing Light’s drain bonus and Dark’s move-away tax.<ref name="change-2026-03-tweak">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1446017#p1446017 Players Committee update].
